tasks.title: Geometric shapes
tasks.description: The balloon moves by itself and jumps when you press the space bar. The rules are the same for each level, only the background changes.

requirements.title: Gravity
requirements.text: The ball is affected by gravity if it does not touch the platforms.

requirements.title: Rules
requirements.text: There are only two rules: touching the "lava" (red) and the target — the green shape.

requirements.title: Jump
requirements.text: We can only control the jumping of the shape. Program a jump that occurs only when you touch the platform (to be able to bounce off).

requirements.title: Going to the beginning of the level
requirements.text: The balloon returns to the starting position whenever the background changes or it touches lava. We need a procedure for that.

requirements.title: *Bonus: modify the game as you see fit.
requirements.text: Add new levels and change rules and controls.
